visual_nodes.text_content: Figure 1: An overview of our segmentation framework consisting of three models: i) Primary segmentation model generates a semantic segmentation of objects given an image. This is the main model that is subject to the training and is used at test time. ii) Ancillary segmentation model outputs a segmentation given an image and bounding box. This model generates an initial segmentation for the weak set, which will aid training the primary model. iii) Self-correction module refines segmentations generated by the ancillary model and the current primary model for the weak set. The primary model is trained using the cross-entropy loss that matches its output to either ground-truth segmentation labels for the fully supervised examples or soft refined labels generated by the self-correction module for the weak set.
